name: armis-knowledge-skills-stage
description: STAGE environment (knowledge-api.moose-stg.armis.com). Adds /knowledge-stage, /cwe-fix-stage, /framework-guidance-stage, and /tech-guidance-stage as shell skills that call the backend directly. Reads ARMIS_CLIENT_ID and ARMIS_CLIENT_SECRET; exchanges them for a short-lived JWT on demand. Tenant isolation enforced server-side; no knowledge data stored on disk.
